name: google_tasks
description: View, create, or complete tasks in the user's Google Tasks lists. Call with action='list' for pending tasks, action='task_lists' to see all task lists, action='create' with a list_id and title to add a new task, or action='complete' with a list_id and task_id to mark one done.

action.description: list: pending tasks in the default list. task_lists: all of the user's task lists. create: add a new task (requires title; list_id optional, defaults to '@default'). complete: mark a task done (requires task_id; list_id optional, defaults to '@default').

list_id.description: The task list ID to act on. Get this from a prior task_lists result if the user has multiple lists. Defaults to '@default' (the user's primary list) if omitted.

notes.description: Optional task notes/details. Only used for action='create'.

due.description: Optional due date as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Only used for action='create'.

task_id.description: The task ID to mark complete. Required for action='complete'. Get this from a prior list result's 'id' field - never guess one.
